senses.gloss:
√śā 'sharpen'
present: [3.] śiśāti etc. V.+ śiśanti śiśantu -- śyáti etc. śyāna 
perfect: śaśau -śaśāná 
aorist: [1.] áśīta? aśāt śāyāt -- [6.] aśāsīt 
[future: śāsyati śātā ]
verbal: śitá V.+ śāta E.+ -śā́ya 
[secondary: passive: śāya- -- intensive: śāśā- -- desiderative: śiśāsa- śīśāṅsa- -- causative: śāyaya- ]
derivatives: -śāna śāṇa? C. -śiti V.B. śiśayá RV. 
Divided by BR. into two separate roots, with identical forms.

√sā 'bind'
present: syáti etc. V.+ syáte etc. V.+ -- [9.] sinā́ti etc. -- [5.] asinot -sinvant -- sāmi 
perfect: sasau siṣāya siṣet? siṣye 
aorist: [1.] asāt etc. sāhi sitam sīmáhi seyāt -- [3.] asīṣayat -- [4.] asaiṣīt aseṣṭa -- [6.] asāsīt 
future: [1.] sāsyati siṣyati seṣyati seṣyate -- [2.] sātā setā 
verbal: sitá V.+ sātum sétave -situm sitvā -sā́ya V.+ -sya E.+ -saí 
secondary: passive: sīyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: sāsā- seṣi- -- desiderative: siṣāsa- sisīṣa- -- causative: sāyáyati etc. B.+ 
derivatives: -sā? RV.+ -sāya E.+ -sāyin B.+ -seya C. -sā́na V.+ -sātṛ RV.C. -sya E. -siti V.?C. sétu V.+ setavya C. setṛ́ RV. -sinva? RV. 
It is not practicable to separate the two forms of this root. Its prevailing use with ava has led to its reduction to mere s in some of the forms made from it.
